nodes.description: IERC20 uni_lp LP token address held by LPTokenWrapper, used for staking transfers
_totalSupply private tracker of total staked LP tokens
_balances mapping of user address to staked LP balance
yuan IERC20 reward token address used for payouts and scaling factor lookup
starttime constant timestamp gating staking/reward operations
periodFinish end timestamp of reward distribution
initialRewardRate base reward rate that halves each halveInterval
lastUpdateTime last time reward accounting was updated
distributionTime start timestamp of the current distribution schedule
rewardPerTokenStored accumulated reward per staked token
userRewardPerTokenPaid mapping of checkpointed reward per token per user
rewards mapping of accrued reward owed to each user
rewardDistribution authorized address for notifyRewardAmount
halveInterval constant period after which reward rate halves
DURATION constant total distribution length of 18 days
msg.sender external caller controlling stake, withdraw and reward claims
block.timestamp miner-influenced time used for reward schedule math
uni_lp.safeTransferFrom external ERC20 call pulling staked LP tokens from the user
uni_lp.safeTransfer external ERC20 call returning staked LP tokens to the user
yuan.safeTransfer external ERC20 call paying out rewards to the user
YUAN(yuan).yuansScalingFactor() external untrusted call used to scale rewards
stake(uint256) adds LP to total and user balance and pulls tokens, guarded by updateReward and checkStart
withdraw(uint256) removes LP from total and user balance and returns tokens
exit() convenience function withdrawing full balance then claiming rewards
getReward() zeroes accrued rewards then transfers scaled yuan to caller
notifyRewardAmount(uint256) restricted reward funding that sets schedule and rates
rewardPerToken() computes accumulated reward per staked token
earned(address) computes accrued reward for an account
lastTimeRewardApplicable() min of block.timestamp and periodFinish
getrewardPerTokenAmount() piecewise reward accumulation across halving intervals
rewardRate() view wrapper returning the current fixed reward rate
getFixedRewardRate(uint256) computes halving reward rate for a timestamp
setRewardDistribution(address) owner-only setter of the reward distribution address
totalSupply() view returning the total staked LP amount
balanceOf(address) view returning a user staked LP balance
amount parameter of stake/withdraw controlling LP moved
reward local copy of rewards[msg.sender] in getReward
account parameter of earned/updateReward reward recipient
scalingFactor local result of yuansScalingFactor external call
trueReward local scaled reward amount sent to the user
_timestamp parameter of getFixedRewardRate reward rate calculation
reward parameter of notifyRewardAmount funding amount

edges.reason: msg.sender used to credit the staker balance when staking
msg.sender used to debit the staker balance when withdrawing
msg.sender used to read and zero rewards during getReward
msg.sender is the account passed into earned via updateReward modifier
stake triggers the external safeTransferFrom on the LP token
withdraw triggers the external safeTransfer of LP tokens back to user
getReward performs an external token transfer to msg.sender that could re-enter before accounting settles
getReward calls the external yuansScalingFactor on the untrusted yuan token
getReward reads and zeroes rewards[msg.sender] before payout
exit invokes withdraw for the caller full balance
exit invokes getReward after withdrawing
block.timestamp miner-controllable value feeds lastTimeRewardApplicable
block.timestamp drives getFixedRewardRate reward rate selection
block.timestamp selects the notifyRewardAmount schedule branch
lastTimeRewardApplicable supplies the timestamp to getrewardPerTokenAmount
getrewardPerTokenAmount result feeds rewardPerToken accumulation
rewardPerToken writes the accumulated rewardPerTokenStored
rewardPerToken divides by totalSupply of staked LP
earned references rewardPerTokenStored through rewardPerToken
earned reads the accumulated rewards mapping
earned uses balanceOf for the user staked amount
notifyRewardAmount sets initialRewardRate from the funded reward
notifyRewardAmount sets periodFinish end of distribution
notifyRewardAmount sets distributionTime start of schedule
notifyRewardAmount sets lastUpdateTime checkpoint
onlyRewardDistribution gates notifyRewardAmount to the configured reward distributor
setRewardDistribution owner-only writes rewardDistribution
getFixedRewardRate derives rate by halving initialRewardRate
getFixedRewardRate uses periodFinish to cap time
getFixedRewardRate uses distributionTime as schedule origin
getFixedRewardRate divides elapsed time by halveInterval
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping for the account
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply tracker
stake increases the caller entry in _balances
withdraw decreases the caller entry in _balances
stake increases _totalSupply
withdraw decreases _totalSupply
stake uses the uni_lp token address for the transfer call

normalization_plan.reason: amount parameter is consumed directly by the stake/withdraw logic and should collapse into the stake function node
reward local is a temporary copy of rewards[msg.sender] read inside getReward
account parameter is only used to index reward computations inside earned
scalingFactor temporary holds the yuansScalingFactor result used within getReward
trueReward temporary is the scaled payout amount computed inside getReward
_timestamp parameter is only used for the halving rate lookup inside getFixedRewardRate
reward parameter is the funding amount processed entirely within notifyRewardAmount
